purpose: Fixed synthetic source-grounded acceptance corpus. Inputs are authored test data, not generated user content. Static validation and mock ranks do not demonstrate model fidelity or learned recall.
splitPolicy: All queries and organization cases have explicit tuning or held-out labels. Retrieval target families are disjoint across splits. Do not tune prompts or ranking using held-out expected outcomes; a changed held-out set requires a new corpus version.

seedPolicy.description: Keep every target then fill the requested Idea count with numbered inventory records. Distractors are load fixtures, not evidence of realistic semantic difficulty. Use each query at all account sizes.
